visualReview.summary: The creator approved the v1.0.1 animation-maintenance build after reviewing numbered frame grids, timed GIFs, and light, dark, and checkerboard transparency previews.
notes: Idle uses one canonical body with a native-pixel blink, eliminating full-body flicker.
Failed holds one disappointed pose; reviewing holds one hand-on-chin pose with a native-pixel blink.
Duplicate lower hands were removed from both running directions while retaining the forward fist and cuff-connected rear hand.
Detached extraction debris was removed across the atlas; unused cells and transparent RGB residue remain clear.
